import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    limit = int(data[1])
    arr = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))

    prices = []
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1

        if even == odd and i < n - 1:
            prices.append(abs(arr[i+1] - arr[i]))

    prices.sort()
    count = 0
    spent = 0
    for p in prices:
        if spent + p > limit:
            break
        spent += p
        count += 1

    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
